# MySentry - Full Page Inventory for LLMs

> MySentry is a Safety and Health monitoring app with Emergency Response. It combines panic alarm, fall detection, crash detection, real-time health monitoring (heart rate, HRV, SpO2), emergency contacts, live video response, and 24/7 professional monitoring into one app for individuals, families, seniors, and employers. Plans start at $15/month with a 7-day free trial.

## Product Overview

MySentry turns smartphones and smartwatches into 24/7 personal safety and health monitoring devices. When an emergency is detected automatically (fall, crash, health anomaly) or triggered manually (panic button tap, voice command, smartwatch tap), the system immediately alerts 24/7 professional monitoring agents. Those agents can view live video from the user's phone camera, verify the situation, and dispatch emergency services. At the same time, the user's designated emergency contacts receive instant SMS, push notification, and email alerts with real-time GPS location.

## Core Features

### Panic Button App
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/panic-button-app
One tap or voice command triggers an alert to 24/7 monitoring agents and emergency contacts. Includes discreet activation modes for situations where visible phone use is unsafe. Works on smartphone and smartwatch.

### Fall Detection App
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/fall-detection-app
Uses phone and smartwatch accelerometer and gyroscope sensors to detect falls. If the user does not respond within a 2-minute countdown, an alert is automatically sent to 24/7 monitoring with live video and GPS location.

### Crash Detection
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/crash-detection
Detects vehicle crashes using phone GPS speed data combined with accelerometer impact patterns. Automatically alerts emergency services and contacts when a crash is confirmed.

### 24/7 Professional Monitoring
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/24-7-professional-monitoring
Certified monitoring agents available around the clock. They receive alerts with live video feed, GPS location, and health data. They verify the emergency and dispatch appropriate help. This is not an automated system; real people respond to every alert.

### Emergency Contacts
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/emergency-contacts
Up to 5 designated contacts receive SMS, push notification, and email alerts with real-time GPS location during any emergency event. Contacts do not need the MySentry app to receive alerts.

### Live Video Response
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/live-video-response
During an emergency, the phone camera streams live video to monitoring agents so they can assess the scene, communicate with the user, and provide accurate information to first responders.

### Health Monitoring
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/health-monitoring
Tracks heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen (SpO2), and skin temperature via Apple Watch or Samsung Galaxy Watch. Alerts users and contacts when readings fall outside safe ranges.

### MeetSafe Check-Ins
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/meetsafe-check-ins
Timed safety check-ins for meetings, dates, or appointments. If the user does not check in by the timer deadline, an alert is sent to monitoring and emergency contacts.

### Safety Check-In App
URL: https://mysentry.ai/features/safety-check-in-app
Scheduled and on-demand check-ins for lone workers, seniors, and anyone in a potentially risky situation. Missed check-ins trigger automatic alerts.

## Audience Segments

### Women's Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/females
Discreet panic activation, location sharing, and 24/7 monitoring for women walking alone, dating, running, or traveling solo.

### Senior Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/seniors
Fall detection, health monitoring, and emergency response designed for independent seniors and their family caregivers.

### Family Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/families
Connected safety for the whole family: teen driver crash detection, child location sharing, senior parent monitoring, and family emergency alerts.

### Employer / Workforce Safety
URL: https://mysentry.ai/employers
Lone worker protection, incident detection, compliance support, and 24/7 monitoring for field employees across industries.
